summary: Frontend/UI test of Lefteria FC OS preview (SvelteKit + .NET via ASGI bridge) against /app/memory/product/phase1/journeys.md. Playwright on the public preview URL, plus curl for JRN-1/2. All in-scope journeys PASS: JRN-1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 8 (one wrong-code attempt only), 9, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 18 (coach), 19, 20, 21, 22. JRN-3/4/10/17 were not tested, as instructed. No workspace wiring problems found: cookies, sessions, role switching, RSVP writes and profile writes all work through the bridge.

minor.issue: Returns 503 for the coach. postgres.log shows 'ERROR: coach_targets_limit' raised by club.read_mobile_coach_feedback_targets: the fixture roster (~200 'roster peer' players) is over the function's limit. This is the repo's own guard reacting to its own fixture size, not bridge wiring. Not part of any journey.

Returns 503 public_sections_unavailable both through the bridge and directly at 127.0.0.1:5080. The repository returns null because no public sections snapshot is exported/imported. /shop therefore shows the repo's explicit Unavailable state (acceptable for JRN-6). Shop content only appears once the owner publishes sections.

ui_bugs.issue: Oct 12 FC match 'Fictional home – Fictional away' shows the start time as raw '12:30:00.1234567' instead of HH:MM. Likely repo/fixture behaviour (start_time rendered as-is). Cosmetic.
Wrong OTP error text is English 'Invalid code' in an otherwise Greek UI. It comes from the repo's MobileAuthService.cs:616, so it is existing behaviour.

action_items: None blocking. The journeys in scope pass.
Optional: tell the user that /shop stays in the 'unavailable' state and /news and /team stay empty until public content is published after owner setup.
Optional, repo-level and no product change required: coach feedback targets return 503 (coach_targets_limit) with the 200-player fixture roster.
critical_code_review_comments: Bridge/wiring: auth cookies, CSRF-style X-Lefteria-Admin header, POST bodies and 4xx/5xx status codes all pass through correctly (403 setup, 401 login, 503 OTP delivery and 503 public sections were all reported faithfully).
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md phones +999508474740001/2/3 with code 123456. Admin: one made-up sign-in and ONE wrong setup code ('a'x64). The real owner setup was not touched or attempted.
